name: eclipticam-hq16
label: HQ16
label_notes: Peter's name for it (2026-10-13): HQ camera + 16 mm lens. It ran its first ~25 minutes on 10-13 as eclipticam-hq, writing to night/2026-10-13/hq/; those frames were moved into hq16/ at the rename.
camera: Raspberry Pi HQ Camera (IMX477) + 16 mm C-mount lens
cam_idx_notes: CSI port cam1 on the Pi 5, beside v3w (imx708_wide) on cam0. Pinned in /boot/firmware/config.txt with camera_auto_detect=0, dtoverlay=imx708,cam0 and dtoverlay=imx477,cam1,rotation=0 (hand-set 2026-10-13; ansible to own it).
lens_notes: Manual 16 mm C-mount lens, fixed focus and iris: neither is under software control, so lens_position is null and the FITS carry no LENSPOS. MOUNT IS INCOMPLETE: the C-CS adapter ring was missing, so the lens is screwed straight into a back-focus ring wound out ~6 turns and grips only a couple of threads. 2x 5 mm C-CS adapters due 2026-10-14; refitting (ring fully in, adapter, lens) disturbs focus and possibly pointing, so it ends epoch 1. Focus 2026-10-13 was 'will have to do' at dusk, not a star-verified best; aperture setting not recorded.
plate_scale_notes: SOLVED 2026-10-13 by astro-deliverables (astrometry.net on muppet, binned frame 1791927010433, ~22:30 BST): 39.8 arcsec per 2x2 binned pixel = 19.9 per photosite at full res (0.005528 deg); field 22.41 x 16.85 deg; centre RA 332.47 Dec -9.98 at that moment; up is -162.2 deg E of N. WCS at muppet ~/tmp/hqsolve/hqbin.wcs. Nominal was 19.98 (1.55 um / 16 mm). Epoch 1 only: refitting the lens with the C-CS adapter may shift it slightly.
position_index_notes: Calibration epoch, same convention as astrocam and eclipticam-v3w: INCREMENT whenever the camera, lens or mounting changes. Stamped as POSINDEX.

1.notes: First light. Lens without its C-CS adapter (see lens_notes); ends when the adapter is fitted.

pedestal_notes: CHART FLOOR ONLY: the log2(mean/pedestal) axis reference, chosen for footroom below black_level, not a measurement. 200 on this 12-bit sensor is the same place as 50 on the 10-bit IMX708s (x4).
black_level_notes: IMX477 electronic zero in 12-bit LSB-aligned ADU (libcamera tuning 4096 at 16-bit). NOMINAL, not measured: cap the lens for a master dark.
capture_notes: Night streaming params for eclipticam/hq16_night_daemon.py, which reads them (env HQ_EXPOSURE_US / HQ_GAIN override per host). 60 s matches v3w's cadence. buffer_count 2 rather than the house 4 because this 1 GB host also streams v3w at full res; the systemd unit caps the daemon's memory so an OOM takes this camera, not v3w. BUFFER: /mnt/ssd/eclipticam-buffer/hq16 on the local SSD, the first eclipticam stream off the 50M RAM tmpfs (2026-10-13, same night as first light). streaming.py refuses to run unless the buffer is on the /mnt/ssd mount, and the units carry RequiresMountsFor=/mnt/ssd.
rotate_180_notes: The camera IS mounted upside down, but the 180 degree turn is done by the driver (dtoverlay imx477 rotation=0 flips at the sensor), so every tool's output is already upright and libcamera reports RGGB. Do NOT also set a software rotation_180: that would turn the frames back over.
night_layout_notes: night/<night-date>/hq16/HH/<epoch_ms>.fits.fz beside v3w's night/<night-date>/v3w/, written by the shared v3w_uploader.py with V3W_SUBCAM=hq16.
processing_notes: Processed on muppet from bigstore (compute follows the data; eclipticam has ~137 MB free beside v3w). Public from 2026-10-15 (Peter asked for night cards on /astro/eclipticam/hq16); its field is sky only, above v3w's privacy crop (v3w rows 639-1010 vs keep-top 1064), so no privacy crop of its own. Re-check after the C-CS refit moves the pointing. No sky_clear_max_stops yet: a clear night sets it (falls back to 10.0).
night_output_notes: Products go in night/<night>/hq16/ beside the hour dirs, not night/<night>/ where v3w's live (astro/frames.py night_output_dir).
